journal.json:36: "text": "SESSION 4-JUL-2026 PART 3 - Economic engine audit: Found marketplace.py wrote to /app/marketplace.json (ephemeral container disk, NOT Volume) - active data-loss risk, would reset on every deploy. Verified live on Railway post-deploy - code and file both confirmed at new path. ALSO DISCOVERED (not yet fixed): (1) TWO competing /join handlers registered - learn_handlers.py and welcome_handler.py both claim commands=[join], likely causing referral flow to silently fail since welcome_handler writes db[students] without referral_code field that learn_handlers /referral expects. (2) welcome_handler.py and learn_handlers.py bypass state_manager.py entirely, doing raw json.load/dump on relative db.json path instead of using the centralized DB access built last session - same single-source-of-truth risk as journal.json had. (3) Local Termux state/db.json was significantly stale vs Railway live db.json (missing students/courses/admins keys) - must always pull live data via /exec before doing local DB work. (4) orphaned join_fix.py file present in root, unclear if still relevant. NEXT SESSION: resolve duplicate /join handlers, migrate welcome_handler.py and learn_handlers.py to use state_manager.py, decide fate of join_fix.py."

CRITICAL BUG FOUND during live testing: welcome_handler.py join handler used relative path db.json (not state/db.json), which does not exist on Railway (no symlink present there unlike Termux local setup) - caused silent FileNotFoundError crash on every /join call, no user-facing response at all. FIXED: changed all 3 db.json references in welcome_handler.py to state/db.json. Verified live - /join now correctly responds. NOTE: my_progress() function in learn_handlers.py also confirmed dead code (referenced in error messages but /myprogress command never registered) - pre-existing, not touched, flagged for future cleanup. NOTE: SyntaxWarning for invalid escape sequences in welcome_handler.py markdown text (\\_ \\<) - cosmetic, not blocking, low priority."

SLH_DISCOVERY_20260802_211429.txt:2173: journal.json:    "text": "SESSION 4-JUL-2026 PART 8: Discovered parallel work completed economic engine - econ_handler.py with /balance, /buy, /giveme all live and verified working (tested balance 170 -> 160 after /buy ask_credit, real DB writes confirmed). admin_utils.py created to house is_admin() avoiding circular imports. SLH_DISCOVERY_20260802_211429.txt:2175: journal.json:    "text": "SESSION 10-JUL-2026 CLEANUP: Fixed critical NameError crash (payment_handler/econ_handler called before import and before bot creation) - bot was in Crashed state, restored to Online. Verified economy end-to-end live: /fakepay, /balance, /pay, /revenue all working correctly with real DB-backed data (previously /revenue was a hardcoded stub returning Γג¬0, now correctly uses payment_handler.py real implementation). Fixed /admin menu: removed duplicate agentstate/sendagent/inbox lines (copy-paste artifact) and corrected double-HTML-escaped <> entities across bot_stable.py (agent commands, /logs, /exec). Caught and reverted a near-regression: admin_handler.py, handlers/agents_handler.py, and help_handler.py had uncommitted local changes going the WRONG direction (re-escaping < > to < >) - discarded via git checkout before they could be committed and break /help again. Confirmed via import-audit that admin_handler.py, course_handlers.py, join_fix.py, bot_patch*.py, ask_handler.py, advanced_ask_handler.py are all dead code (not imported anywhere in live path) - the apparent handler duplicates for admin/join/pay/agents/etc. are NOT live conflicts, only one real registration path exists per command. Confirmed users/students schema split flagged in 4-Jul session is moot: live db.json only has a 'users' key, no 'students' key exists anymore - no merge needed. MAJOR CLEANUP: removed 56 tracked files (~9,972 lines) of obsolete archive/backup directories (archive_unused_20260702, backup_v2_1782764885, ops/snapshots, archive_old_backups, backups) plus stray .bak/.before_*/.backup files scattered in root and handlers/. Removed 10 additional dead one-off fix scripts (fix_add_broadcast.py, fix_lock.py, onboard_patch.py, etc). Added docs/ (4 Railway inventory/ownership markdown files), manifest.json, and daily tooling scripts (slh_morning.sh, slh_full_diag.sh, slh_safe_diag.sh, pre_change_audit.sh, railway_pre_fix_check.sh, telegram_owner_check.sh) to git tracking so they survive and sync properly. Tagged gold-v1.0 (post economy-fix, pre-cleanup) and gold-v2.0-clean (post full cleanup) as rollback points. Working tree fully clean, Railway Online, POLLING START confirmed multiple times across all deploys with zero errors."
